column2: ["Executive shall not, during Executive's employment with the Company or any Company subsidiary or affiliate and for twelve (12) months after termination of Executive's employment (for any reason whatsoever), without the prior written approval of the Board, directly or indirectly engage in any business or other activity anywhere in the world that competes with the Company in the field of cancer drugs, biopharmaceuticals, therapeutics or treatments, including but not limited to the research, development, testing, manufacture, sale, marketing, or licensing of the same.", "Executive may engage in the prohibited competitive business or other activity during the Non-Competition Period if Executive has the prior written approval of the Board.", "The foregoing prohibition shall not prevent Executive's employment or engagement after termination of Executive's employment by any company or business organization, as long as the activities of any such employment or engagement, in any capacity, do not involve work on matters related to the Business of the Company during Executive's employment with the Company.", "Executive shall be permitted to own securities of a public company not in excess of five percent (5%) of any class of such securities.", "Executive shall be permitted to own stock, partnership interests or other securities of any entity not in excess of five percent (5%) of any class of such securities.", "Ownership by Executive within the permitted five percent (5%) limits shall not be considered to be in competition with the Company."]

["Executive must not, without the prior written approval of the Board, directly or indirectly engage in any business or other activity in the United States or Canada which competes with the Employer in the field of therapeutic antibodies for cancer while Executive is employed at the Employer.", "Executive must not, without the prior written approval of the Board, directly or indirectly engage in any business or other activity in the United States or Canada which competes with the Employer in the field of therapeutic antibodies for cancer for a period of two (2) years after termination of Executive's employment (for any reason whatsoever, whether voluntary or involuntarily).", "Executive must not, without the prior written approval of the Board, directly or indirectly engage in such competing business or other activity whether alone or as a partner, officer, director, consultant, agent, employee or stockholder of any company or other commercial enterprise.", "The foregoing prohibition shall not prevent Executive's employment or engagement after termination of Executive's employment by any company or business organization, as long as the activities of any such employment or engagement, in any capacity, do not involve work on matters related to the products being developed, manufactured, or marketed by the Employer during Executive's employment with the Employer.", "Executive is permitted to own securities of a public company not in excess of five percent of any class of such securities.", "Executive is permitted to own stock, partnership interests or other securities of any entity not in excess of five percent of any class of such securities.", "Ownership by Executive that is permitted under the stated five percent limits shall not be considered to be in competition with the Employer."]

["During Executive's employment with the Company or any Company subsidiary or controlled affiliate and for 24 months after termination of Executive's employment (for any reason, voluntary or involuntary), Executive shall not, without the prior written approval of the Board, directly or indirectly engage in the business of providing professional medical services in a primary care clinic setting (the \"Business\").", "During Executive's employment with the Company or any Company subsidiary or controlled affiliate and for 24 months after termination of Executive's employment, Executive shall not, without the prior written approval of the Board, engage in the Business whether alone or as a partner, officer, director, consultant, agent, employee, representative, or stockholder of any company, entity, or other commercial enterprise, or in any other capacity.", "The prohibition on engaging in the Business does not prevent Executive's employment or engagement after termination of Executive's employment by any company or business organization, as long as the activities of such employment or engagement, in any capacity, do not involve work on matters related to the Business of the Company during Executive's employment with the Company.", "Executive is permitted to own securities of a public company not in excess of 5% of any class of such securities.", "Executive is permitted to own stock, partnership interests, or other securities of any entity not in excess of 5% of any class of such securities.", "Ownership of the securities described (up to the stated 5% limits) shall not be considered to be in competition with the Company."]
